newapi.keyHint: This preview uses a placeholder. Applying writes the saved API key to Codex configuration in plain text.
newapi.title: Relay station
newapi.description: Connect New API to check account quota and configure a Codex model.
newapi.urlHint: Use the site home URL. An API base URL ending in /v1 also works.
newapi.userIdHint: Numeric ID from your site profile; required only for balance queries.
newapi.accessTokenHint: Get this from Personal settings → Security settings to query account quota.
newapi.apiKeyHint: The sk- key from the site's Tokens page, used to list available models.
newapi.storageHint: Credentials stay on this device. Windows encrypts them for the current user. Queries use the proxy from Settings. Enter credentials again when changing sites.
newapi.rawQuotaHint: Site conversion rules are unavailable; showing raw quota units.
newapi.balanceEmpty: Save the site, user ID and user access token, then check the balance.
newapi.balanceHint: This is internal usage credit, with units and conversion defined by the site, not withdrawable cash.
newapi.responsesHint: Codex uses the Responses API. Being listed does not guarantee a model supports it.
newapi.useDefault: Leave blank for Codex model defaults
newapi.contextHint: Set only after confirming the model's limit. Model names are not used to guess it.
newapi.compactHint: Must be below the context length. Leave blank for Codex to decide.
newapi.envHint: By default Codex reads the API key from AIMAMI_NEWAPI_KEY in its launch environment. The preview contains no secret.
newapi.writeKey: Write the saved API key to Codex configuration in plain text (no environment variable)
newapi.applied: Configuration written. Restart Codex to apply it. Set AIMAMI_NEWAPI_KEY first when using environment authentication.
newapi.forgetConfirm: Remove the locally saved connection and credentials. Previously applied Codex configuration is unaffected.
newapi.applyConfirm: Update the default Codex model, provider and context settings, backing up config.toml first. Other settings are preserved. Authentication uses AIMAMI_NEWAPI_KEY.
newapi.applyKeyConfirm: Update Codex model settings and write the API key into config.toml in plain text. The original file is backed up first. Backups may contain previous credentials; keep them private.

errors.storage: Could not read or save the local connection. Check permissions. Encrypted data requires the Windows user who saved it.
errors.url: Enter an http:// or https:// site URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
errors.userId: Enter a valid numeric user ID.
errors.token: Enter a valid token without spaces or line breaks.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check the site URL, network and proxy.
errors.timeout: Request timed out. Retry or check the proxy.
errors.auth: Authentication failed or the site blocked the request. Check the user token, user ID or model API key.
errors.notFound: Endpoint not found. Check the site URL and New API compatibility.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.redirect: The site requires a redirect. Use the final site URL and save credentials again.
errors.server: The site is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.response: The site returned an unexpected response format.
errors.rejected: The site rejected the query. Check token permissions and user ID.
errors.userMismatch: Returned user ID does not match. Check the user token and ID.
errors.context: Enter valid positive integers. The compaction threshold must be below context length.
errors.model: Fetch and select a valid model first.
errors.configRead: Could not read Codex configuration. Check file permissions.
errors.configParse: Invalid Codex configuration. The original file was preserved; fix it and retry.
